public.title: Mini Object-relational Mapper III
public.description: input {users,posts,select,includePosts}; users are {id,name}, posts are {id,userId,title}. For each user in source order, return only fields listed in select (id and/or name), and if includePosts add posts containing full matching post rows in source order. Empty select emits empty objects unless relations are included. At most 12 users and 12 posts; posts may reference absent users. This is a fixed one-to-many ORM projection/include adapter. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Project each user and scan posts for its foreign key. O(users times posts plus projection/output) time and output-sized space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
